name: Sawatari Shizuku
source:
Heroine of the second story. One of [url=/c6813]Akihito's[/url] childhood friends who suddenly moved out two years ago, and ever since then hasn't really kept in contact with Akihito.

A kind and energetic girl admired by everyone who is also an ace at rhythmic gymnastics. She loves sweets but has recently been concerned about her weight.
